prompt: Give me titles of several good textbooks on rhetorics that include explanation of the concept "enargeia".
response: "Enargeia" is a rhetorical device that can be explained in many textbooks on rhetoric. Some good ones include "The Art of Rhetoric" by Aristotle, "Rhetorical Devices: A Manual of Style" by Veatch, and "The Rhetorical Tradition: Readings from Classical Times to the Present" edited by John Patrick Greene. These books provide detailed explanations of enargeia and its usage in rhetoric.
